history.title: 1 million units sold
history.summary: Crossed 1 million cumulative units sold across the core routine line.

history.title: Lasting Radiance Science Campaign
history.summary: The campaign utilized a premium, science-forward headline to position the product as a solution for lasting skin resilience, successfully driving strong engagement among quality-conscious segments.

insights.observation: Skincare-routine reels from real customers outperformed studio flatlay images on saves and comments across recent launches.
Posts that broke down the full active-ingredient list drove visibly higher repeat-purchase rate than posts making benefit-only claims.
Multi-product routine bundles discounted as a set lifted average order value more than single-SKU percentage-off discounts.
GlowRoot successfully leveraged a science-backed, aspirational narrative to achieve strong resonance with quality-conscious consumers.
